comparison.objective: Gently place a stir bar into a tilted round-bottom flask and return the flask upright to its ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually hold and tilt fragile glassware while guiding a small bar into its neck without a damaging impact.
comparison.success_condition: Bar remains inside, flask returns upright and released in its ring, and impact/drop/tip thresholds are never violated.
comparison.reason: Fragile-vessel support and gentle insertion are different from damper setting adjustment and repeated stopping tests.
